hypotheses.text: If forward Yusuf Benali had been 5 m closer to Leo Marchetti, Marchetti's chance to score would have dropped noticeably, showing the assist exploited space in front of the striker that a nearer marking forward could have closed.

If midfielder Theo Varga had been 5 m closer to Leo Marchetti, Marchetti's chance to score would have been reduced, indicating the passer's choice took advantage of the creator-facing space that a tighter midfield cover would have limited.
